messages:
Aisha (Partnerships): Morning team — planning next SI onboarding cohort for Aug. Need to lock training cadence, playbook version, and cert criteria. Thoughts?
Diego (Solutions Eng): +1. Can we do 2 half-days + office hours? That worked for previous bootcamps.
Leah (Enablement): 2 half-days is good. Recommend pre-work lab: quick infra prep doc + a 45m recorded module on model routing.
Sam (Trainer): I can run the lab. Need updated lab VM image; current one still uses old hf weights. I will spin new image by Tue.
Tom (EdgeWave SI): From SI side — we need a marketplace listing checklist and an approval window. Can we get a template for joint announcement?
Aisha (Partnerships): Yep. I'll attach announcement checklist and a draft PR cadence. We'll do marketplace checklist + legal signoff step.
PartnerBot: New onboarding cohort created: cohort-2024-08-14. Ops ticket #OPS-4821
Diego (Solutions Eng): Suggest certification pass/fail based on 3 rubrics: deployment, latency tuning, troubleshooting. Pass = all three green or one red + remediation plan.
Leah (Enablement): I'll draft rubrics. Also propose a 20-question practical exam — mix of multiple choice and short config tasks.
Tom (EdgeWave SI): Can we reserve a Dedicated slot for the hands-on day? Need GPUs for perf tuning.
Aisha (Partnerships): I'll book Dedicated capacity for Aug 14 hands-on. @Sam can you confirm VM image link once done?
Sam (Trainer): Will post image + prework link by EOD Tue. Also adding a short troubleshooting flowchart to the playbook :memo:
Diego (Solutions Eng): Perfect. Once rubrics draft is up, I'll add acceptance criteria for marketplace listing.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks all — next sync Fri 11am PT. I'll post agenda later. :rocket:
